## TagsInput.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `value` :: The tags. Bindable; works controlled and uncontrolled.
- `onValueChange` :: Called with the new list whenever a tag is added or removed.
- `max` :: The most tags allowed. Further additions are ignored.
- `validate` :: Return `true` to accept a tag, `false` or an error message to reject it.
- `allowDuplicates` :: When true, a tag that is already in the list can be added again.
- `editable` :: Allow double-clicking an existing tag to edit it inline.
- `delimiter` :: Delimiter character or RegExp used to split drafted or pasted tags.
- `placeholder` :: Placeholder shown in the typing area while the list is empty.
- `size` :: The control height. Text follows this unless `textSize` is set. @default 'lg'
- `gap` :: Space between the chips row and the message under the field on the shared gap ladder.
- `textSize` :: The text scale, independent of the control height. Follows `size` when omitted, and sets the scale of the chips.
- `textColor` :: The ink of the message under the field, danger by default because the message reports a rejection.
- `shape` :: The corner shape. @default 'modern'
- `variant` :: `outline` is a bordered field, `secondary` a tinted one without a border, `ghost` is bare until hovered or focused. @default 'outline'
- `invalid` :: Marks the field invalid (red border, `aria-invalid`). Inside a `Field` it follows the field's error unless set.
- `disabled` :: Blocks pointer and keyboard input, and dims the frame.
